description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 截图时界面卡住超过 0.3 秒，诊断日志会记下当时程序各个线程在做什么，用来查“按下截图键后黑屏或卡一两秒”的原因。功能和权限没有变化。设置 → 插件 → 插件库中安装或更新。最低主程序版本为 0.18.0。
notes.en: When the interface stops answering for more than 0.3 s during a capture, the diagnostics record what each thread of the program was doing, to find why some PCs go black or stall for a second or two after the capture key. No change in features or permissions. Install or update through Settings → Plugins → Library. Requires WinShun 0.18.0.
